description: An awesome list that curates the best Kotlin Multiplatform libraries, tools and more.

latest_release.name: Issue 14
latest_release.body:
# Issue 14

## New Awesome Libraries

### 🌎 Network

[Ketch](https://github.com/linroid/Ketch) - download manager [![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/linroid/Ketch?style=flat)](https://github.com/linroid/Ketch) [![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/com.linroid.ketch/core)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/com.linroid.ketch/core)
> Kotlin Multiplatform download manager for Android, iOS and JVM with parallel downloads, pause and resume, queues, scheduling and speed limits. Supports HTTP/HTTPS, FTP/FTPS and BitTorrent/magnet links.

### 📱 Device

[Kamera](https://github.com/Kashif-E/Kamera) - A camera library [![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Kashif-E/Kamera?style=flat)](https://github.com/Kashif-E/Kamera) [![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/io.github.kashif-mehmood-km/camerak)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.kashif-mehmood-km/camerak)
> A camera library for Compose Multiplatform

[KSensor](https://github.com/ShadAdman/KSensor) - Live Sensors [![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/ShadAdman/KSensor?style=flat)](https://github.com/ShadAdman/KSensor) [![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/io.github.shadadman/ksensor-core)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.shadadman/ksensor-core)
> Live Sensors/States data from Android & iOS targets

[KMP WorkManager](https://github.com/brewkits/kmpworkmanager) - Background task scheduling [![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/brewkits/kmpworkmanager?style=flat)](https://github.com/brewkits/kmpworkmanager) [![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/dev.brewkits/kmpworkmanager)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/dev.brewkits/kmpworkmanager)
> A Kotlin Multiplatform library for background task scheduling on Android and iOS, with one-time and periodic tasks, constraints, and persistent task chains.

[KHealth](https://github.com/shubhamsinghshubham777/KHealth) - Health data access [![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/shubhamsinghshubham777/KHealth?style=flat)](https://github.com/shubhamsinghshubham777/KHealth) [![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/io.github.shubhamsinghshubham777/khealth)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/io.github.shubhamsinghshubham777/khealth)
> A Kotlin Multiplatform library providing a unified, type-safe API for Android Health Connect and Apple HealthKit on iOS and watchOS, with health record reads, writes, and permission management.

### 🔑 Crypto

[Signum](https://github.com/a-sit-plus/signum) - Crypto/PKI/ASN.1 Library [![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/a-sit-plus/signum?style=flat)](https://github.com/a-sit-plus/signum) [![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/at.asitplus.signum/indispensable)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/at.asitplus.signum/indispensable)
> Multiplatform crypto with ECDSA, RSA, ECDH, AES, HMAC, KDF (PBKDF2, HKDF, scrypt), hardware-backed crypto on Android/iOS, platform-native attestation, biometric authentication, X.509 certificates, CSRs, JOSE/COSE data structures, and a full ASN.1 parser/encoder with DSL.

### 📁 File

[Kompress](https://github.com/karmakrafts/Kompress) - Compression APIs for Kotlin Multiplatform [![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/karmakrafts/Kompress?style=flat)](https://github.com/karmakrafts/Kompress) [![Maven Central](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/dev.karmakrafts.kompress/kompress-core)](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/dev.karmakrafts.kompress/kompress-core)
> Blazingly fast compression- and archive-APIs implemented in pure Kotlin for Kotlin Multiplatform

### 🗃 Serializer
